# Bubba Gump Shrimp Co.

> > Forrest Gump-themed seafood restaurant chain offering casual dining, catering, and merchandise since 1996

Bubba Gump Shrimp Co. operates locations across the USA and internationally, serving Southern-style seafood in a family-friendly atmosphere inspired by the iconic film. The restaurant is part of the Landry's restaurant group and offers dining, takeout, catering through ezCater, private events, and branded merchandise.
